decision_rationale: The abstract and full text describe a "generative pre-trained transformer decoder-only singlecell foundation model" trained on 2.76 million cells across 7 cancer types. The model is pre-trained broadly and used for zero-shot generation of full expression values, which supports both generative and foundation-model evidence.
evidence_snippet: "generative pre-trained transformer decoder-only singlecell foundation model"; "performs zero-shot generation of full expression values for all genes in each generated cell"; pre-training on "2.76 million cells" from "7 cancer types" across 699 tumor samples for broad pre-training and transfer learning
